Dewing Less Campaign

Dallas, TX / 202428 photographs
About the project

For FITISH’s Fall 2024 beauty launch, we created Dewing Less, a campaign that pairs bold skincare visuals with a relaxed, nighttime, girls-night-in feel. We shot close-up beauty and product imagery at Production House, Kelsey Ikler’s studio in Dallas.

Kelsey produced the shoot and did hair and makeup, and the visuals lean into FITISH’s balance of chill and chic, highlighting both the product’s glow and the lifestyle around it. I shot both photography and video, capturing stills and motion for use across platforms.
